style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley White Berry Christmas Wreath & Garland Set
style.toneOfVoice: If you d rather step away from traditional red and green, this matched pair is a quieter way to do Christmas. Clusters of soft white berries give both pieces texture and detail without introducing any colour. The all-white palette works alongside silver, gold, blush, and copper, and holds its own in a more minimal scheme. The 55cm wreath suits a standard internal door, and the 180cm garland suits a mantel, doorframe, or banister. For indoor use only. Keep away from open flame and heat sources. Wipe with a dry or lightly damp cloth. Store flat in a cool, dry place between seasons. Dimensions(mm): Height: 550 Width: 1800 Depth: 550.
